en: Black-and-white postcard view of a waterfront with small rowboats in the foreground and a low bridge crossing a canal or river. On the right side stands an industrial-looking building with a tall smokestack and the word "TURISTBYRÅ" on it, suggesting a tourist office. Behind the bridge are low-rise buildings and a slightly hilly, tree-covered background. The image has printed captions at the bottom identifying the place and the photographer/publisher.
